## REACTOME analysis
Constructs Reactome pathway gene sets, generates ranked gene lists for the recovered class in each APNS domain, performs FGSEA, and exports per-domain Reactome enrichment results.
```{r}
# Reactome gene sets 
reactome_db <- msigdbr(
  species = "Homo sapiens",
  category = "C2",
  subcategory = "CP:REACTOME")

Reactome_pathways <- reactome_db %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gs_name) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(genes = list(gene_symbol), .groups = "drop") %>%
  deframe()


Reactome_analysis <- function(data, APNS, recovered_groups) {

  output_dir <- "FGSEA/REACTOME/Results per APNS 6-3"
  dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  recovered_class <- recovered_groups[[APNS]]

  class_data <- data %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$APNS == !!APNS,
                  Class == recovered_class)

  ranked_genes <- create_ranked_genes(class_data)

  fgsea_results <- perform_fgsea(ranked_genes, Reactome_pathways) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      APNS = APNS,
      Class = recovered_class,
      `Recovery Group` = "Recovered",
      leadingEdge = sapply(leadingEdge, paste, collapse = ";")) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(padj)

  results_file <- file.path(output_dir,paste(APNS, recovered_class, "FGSEA_REACTOME.csv", sep = "_"))

  readr::write_csv(fgsea_results, results_file)
}

for (a in APNS_ordered) {
  Reactome_analysis(all_DEA_results, a, recovered_groups)
}
```

### Load in results
```{r}
reactome_dir <- "FGSEA/REACTOME/Results per APNS 6-3"

reactome_all <- list.files(
  reactome_dir,
  pattern = "FGSEA_REACTOME\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE) %>%
  map_dfr(~ read_csv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
            mutate(source_file = basename(.x)))


reactome_sig_counts <- reactome_all %>%
  filter(padj < 0.01) %>%
  mutate(direction = case_when(
    NES > 0 ~ "Reactomes Enriched at M6",
    NES < 0 ~ "Reactomes Enriched at ED")) %>%
  group_by(APNS, direction) %>%
  summarise(n_pathways = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = direction,
    values_from = n_pathways,
    values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(Total = `Reactomes Enriched at M6` + `Reactomes Enriched at ED`) %>%
  arrange(match(APNS, APNS_ordered))

write.csv(reactome_sig_counts, "FGSEA/REACTOME/Summaries/APNS Significant Reactomes Count Global.csv")
```

### Export Excel 
```{r}
# workbook + styles
reactome_wb <- createWorkbook()
header_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", halign = "center", valign = "center")
body_center <- createStyle(halign = "center", valign = "center")
body_left <- createStyle(halign = "left", valign = "center")


reactome_all <- reactome_all %>%
    mutate(APNS = factor(APNS, levels = APNS_ordered))


reactome_summary <- reactome_all %>%
  filter(padj < 0.01) %>%
  group_by(pathway) %>%
  summarise(
    n_APNS_sig = n_distinct(APNS),
    APNS_sig = paste(sort(unique(as.character(APNS))), collapse = ", "),
    avg_pval = mean(pval, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_padj = mean(padj, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_log2err = mean(log2err, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_ES = mean(ES, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_NES = mean(NES, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_APNS_sig), avg_padj) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ format_num(.x)))

write.csv(reactome_summary, "FGSEA/REACTOME/Summaries/APNS Reactomes Summary.csv")


make_sheet_name <- function(name, existing) {
  nm <- str_replace_all(name, "[:\\\\/*?\\[\\]]", "_")
  nm <- substr(nm, 1, 31)

  if (nm %in% existing) {
    i <- 2
    repeat {
      nm2 <- substr(paste0(nm, "_", i), 1, 31)
      if (!(nm2 %in% existing)) return(nm2)
      i <- i + 1
    }
  }
  nm
}

existing_sheets <- character(0)

for (apns in levels(reactome_all$APNS)) {

  df_sub <- reactome_all %>%
    filter(APNS == apns) %>%
    arrange(Class, padj, pval)

  if (nrow(df_sub) == 0) next

  df_sub <- df_sub %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ format_num(.x)), `Recovery Group` = "Recovered")

  sheet_name <- make_sheet_name(as.character(apns), existing_sheets)
  existing_sheets <- c(existing_sheets, sheet_name)

  addWorksheet(reactome_wb, sheet_name)

  writeData(reactome_wb, sheet = sheet_name, x = df_sub, withFilter = FALSE)

  # header
  addStyle(reactome_wb, sheet = sheet_name, style = header_style,
           rows = 1, cols = 1:ncol(df_sub), gridExpand = TRUE)

  # body default (center)
  addStyle(reactome_wb, sheet = sheet_name, style = body_center,
           rows = 2:(nrow(df_sub) + 1), cols = 1:ncol(df_sub), gridExpand = TRUE)

  # left-align pathway + leadingEdge only
  left_cols <- which(names(df_sub) %in% c("pathway", "leadingEdge"))
    if (length(left_cols) > 0) {
      addStyle(reactome_wb, sheet = sheet_name, style = body_left, rows = 2:(nrow(df_sub) + 1), 
              cols = left_cols, gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)
    }

  setColWidths(reactome_wb, sheet = sheet_name, cols = 1:ncol(df_sub), widths = "auto")

}

saveWorkbook(reactome_wb, "FGSEA/REACTOME/Summaries/All_APNS_Reactome_FGSEA.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
```

### Plot 
```{r}
# identify Reactome pathways significant across all 10 APNS
reactome_pathways_keep <- reactome_all %>%
  mutate(
    padj = as.numeric(padj),
    pathway_clean = gsub("^REACTOME_", "", pathway)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj) & padj <= 0.01) %>%
  distinct(APNS, pathway_clean) %>%
  count(pathway_clean, name = "n_APNS_sig") %>%
  filter(n_APNS_sig >= 10) %>%
  pull(pathway_clean)

# rank only Reactome pathways significant across all 10 APNS
top_pathways <- reactome_all %>%
  mutate(
    padj = as.numeric(padj),
    NES = as.numeric(NES),
    pathway_clean = gsub("^REACTOME_", "", pathway)) %>%
  filter(pathway_clean %in% reactome_pathways_keep) %>%
  group_by(pathway_clean) %>%
  summarise(
    padj_mean = mean(padj, na.rm = TRUE),
    NES_mean = mean(NES, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(weighted_score = -log10(padj_mean) * abs(NES_mean)) %>%
  arrange(desc(weighted_score)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15)

pathway_levels <- top_pathways %>%
  arrange(desc(weighted_score)) %>%
  pull(pathway_clean)

heatmap_reactome <- reactome_all %>%
  mutate(
    padj = as.numeric(padj),
    NES  = as.numeric(NES),
    APNS = factor(APNS, levels = APNS_ordered),
    pathway_clean = gsub("^REACTOME_", "", pathway)) %>%
  filter(pathway_clean %in% pathway_levels) %>%
  group_by(APNS, pathway_clean) %>%
  summarise(
    padj = min(padj, na.rm = TRUE),
    NES = NES[which.min(padj)][1],
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    APNS = factor(APNS, levels = rev(APNS_ordered)),
    pathway_clean = factor(pathway_clean, levels = pathway_levels),
    neglogFDR = if_else(!is.na(padj) & padj > 0, -log10(padj), NA_real_))

heatmap_reactome_grid <- tidyr::crossing(
  APNS = factor(APNS_ordered, levels = APNS_ordered),
  pathway_clean = factor(pathway_levels, levels = pathway_levels)) %>%
  left_join(heatmap_reactome, by = c("APNS", "pathway_clean"))


reactome_pathway_labels <- rev(c(
    NEUTROPHIL_DEGRANULATION = "Neutrophil degranulation",
    TOLL_LIKE_RECEPTOR_CASCADES = "TLR cascades",
    TOLL_LIKE_RECEPTOR_TLR1_TLR2_CASCADE = "TLR1 and TLR2 cascade",
    TOLL_LIKE_RECEPTOR_9_TLR9_CASCADE = "TLR9 cascade",
    INTERLEUKIN_1_SIGNALING = "IL-1 signaling",
    ANTIGEN_PROCESSING_CROSS_PRESENTATION = "Antigen processing cross presentation"))
 

hm_plot <- heatmap_reactome_grid %>%
  mutate(pathway_clean = factor(
    pathway_clean,
    levels = names(reactome_pathway_labels),
    labels = reactome_pathway_labels)) 

hm_plot <- hm_plot %>%
  mutate(
    neglogFDR = if_else(!is.na(padj) & padj > 0, -log10(padj), NA_real_),
    neglogFDR_cap = pmin(neglogFDR, 10))

range(hm_plot$neglogFDR, na.rm = TRUE) #2.039533 37.295967
range(hm_plot$NES, na.rm = TRUE) #-2.164236 -1.630376


Reactome_heatmap <- ggplot(hm_plot, aes(x = APNS, y = pathway_clean)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 2, fill = "white", color = "grey75", stroke = 0.35) +
  geom_point(aes(size = if_else(!is.na(padj) & padj <= 0.01, neglogFDR_cap, NA_real_),
                 fill = if_else(!is.na(padj) & padj <= 0.01, NES, NA_real_)),
             shape = 21, color = "grey20", stroke = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE) +

  scale_size_area(name = "-log10(FDR)", 
                  max_size = 8, 
                  limits = c(2, 10), 
                  breaks = c(2, 6, 10), 
                  labels = c("2", "6", ">10")) +

  scale_fill_gradient2(name = "NES\n(ED \u2192 6M)",
                       low = "steelblue3", high = "skyblue2",
                       midpoint = 0, na.value = "white", 
                       limits = c(-2.25, 0),
                       breaks = c(-2, 0)) +
guides(fill = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top",
                             title.hjust = 0.5,
                             barheight = unit(2.25, "cm"),
                             barwidth = unit(0.6, "cm"),
                             title.theme = element_text(size = 11, margin = margin(b = 8)))) +
  labs(y = "Reactome Pathways", x= NULL, title = NULL) + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),

    axis.text.x.top = element_text(color = "black", size = 12, angle = 35, hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = -22)),
    axis.ticks.x.top = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),

    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
    axis.title = element_blank(),

    legend.position = "right",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.just = "center",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 11), 
    legend.margin = margin(t = -5, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0), 
    plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(mult = c(.15, .15))) +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top", expand = expansion(mult = c(.075, .075))) 

ggsave(filename = "FGSEA/REACTOME/Plots/Top REACTOMES by APNS 6-4 v2.jpg", plot = Reactome_heatmap,
  height = 3.5, width = 7, dpi = 300)

```

## Combine 
```{r}

gobp_all <- gobp_all %>%
  mutate(Database = "GO-BP")

reactome_all <- reactome_all %>%
  mutate(Database = "REACTOME")


pathway_results <- rbind(gobp_all, reactome_all)

pathway_results_export <- pathway_results %>%
  dplyr::select(Database, APNS,`Recovery Group`, Class, pathway, pval, padj, log2err, ES, NES, size, leadingEdge) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Pathway = pathway, 
                `P Value` = pval, 
                FDR = padj, 
                Log2Err = log2err, 
                `Pathway Size` = size,
                `Leading Edge Genes` = leadingEdge) %>% 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ format_num(.x))) %>%
  mutate(APNS = factor(APNS, levels = APNS_ordered), 
         Class = factor(Class, levels = class_order)) %>%
  arrange(APNS, Class)

write.csv(pathway_results_export, "FGSEA/Combined_FGSEA_Results.csv")

```
